question: Which schema provides performance data and alert details to review in SAP HANA mini-checks? A. SAP_XS_USAGE B. COCKPIT_MONITOR C. _SYS_SQL_ANALYZER D. _SYS_STATISTICS
Which system privilege do you need to redistribute tables across the hosts in a scale-out system? A. WORKLOAD ADMIN B. RESOURCE ADMIN C. DATA ADMIN D. OPTIMIZER ADMIN

Which preparation tasks do you need to perform before starting the copy and move process for a tenant database? (Choose two.) A. Create credentials for authenticated access to the source system. B. Configure a secure connection from target system to source system. C. Back up the source tenant database. D. Create a tenant on the target system identical to the source system.
What cryptographic libraries are supported in SAP HANA by default? (Choose two.) A. OpenSSL B. Libgcrypt C. CommonCryptoLib D. wolfCrypt

Which prerequisites of the primary system and the secondary system are mandatory before you can activate SAP HANA system replication with secondary time travel? (Choose two.) A. Both systems are located in the same data center. B. Both must have the same SAP HANA version. C. An explicit read-only connection between both systems must be available. D. The CPU architecture must be identical.

What do you need in a multitenant database container (MDC) system to run queries across tenant databases? (Choose two.) A. The user in the source system must be associated with a user in the target database. B. The bidirectional communication channel must be whitelisted. C. The user in the source system must have sufficient privileges in the target database. D. The cross-tenant database communication must be explicitly activated.
Which system usage types are automatically assigned to tiles in the SAP HANA cockpit? (Choose three.) A. Quality assurance B. Development C. Production D. Custom E. Test
Which connection type is used by default for restricted users? A. JDBC B. ODBC C. HTTP/S D. OLEDB

Which actions are performed during the database migration option (DMO) procedure when you select the ‘Do not compare table contents’ option? (Choose two.) A. The clustered tables are declustered. B. A check sum is generated every 10000 rows. C. A row count is executed for the migrated tables. D. The content comparison is performed for repository tables.

How are user group administrators and user groups related? (Choose two.) A. Only one user group per user group administrator B. Multiple user groups per user group administrator C. Multiple user group administrators per user group D. Only one user group administrator per user group

Which tasks can you perform when using the SAP HANA database lifecycle manager (HDBLCM) from the SAP HANA installation media? (Choose two.) A. Rename the SAP HANA database system. B. Extract the SAP HANA database system components. C. Uninstall the SAP HANA database system and its components. D. Update the SAP HANA database system and its components.
Which tools are integrated into the SAP HANA cockpit? (Choose three.) A. HDBAdmin B. HANASitter C. SQL Analyzer D. SQL Console E. Database Explorer
Which services can you stop in the SAP HANA cockpit from the SYSTEMDB Manage Services app? (Choose two.) A. Preprocessor B. Daemon C. Compile server D. Index server

Which prerequisites must be fulfilled to rename a tenant database in the SAP HANA cockpit? (Choose two.) A. The on-disk tenant directory should be a mount point. B. The tenant database is not part of a move operation. C. The tenant database is stopped. D. The tenant database must be unloaded from memory.

Which migration features are supported when using the database migration option (DMO) of Software Update Manager (SUM)? (Choose two.) A. A database migration from SAP HANA to SAP ASE can be performed. B. The SAP system can be AS Java-based if the release is 7.50 or higher. C. The primary application server (PAS) can be moved to a target system landscape. D. A database migration from Oracle to SAP MaxDB can be performed.

What additional action do you need to perform after you create a new tenant in an SAP HANA system replication configuration? A. Start the tenant database. B. Copy the tenant database. C. Back up the tenant database. D. Restart the secondary system.
Which tool shows you information about the list of tablets to be pre-loaded during an SAP HANA system start? A. HDBAdmin B. hdbcons C. sapcontrol D. RecoverStateChecker.py

Which technology is utilized by the Performance Warehouse option in the transaction DBACOCKPIT? A. SAP Business Intelligence B. SAP Data Warehouse Cloud C. SAP Intelligent Query (SAP IQ) D. SAP Analytics Cloud
What are the merge methods that are triggered by the SAP HANA system? (Choose two.) A. Critical B. Forced C. Smart D. Auto

Which SAP HANA security tasks can be performed in combination with a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) server? (Choose two.) A. User creation B. User group assignment C. Password policy configuration D. Role assignment

Which prerequisites have to be fulfilled before you reset a database migration option (DMO) procedure? (Choose two.) A. A cleanup has already been triggered. B. The SUM folder needs to exist. C. The DMO procedure hasn’t reached downtime yet. D. The source database is up and running.
Which operating system process takes care of starting the SAP HANA database system services? A. hdbdaemon B. hdbrsutil C. sapstart D. sapstartsrv
Which types of backups can you use to copy an SAP HANA tenant database? (Choose two.) A. Delta database backup B. Data snapshot C. Full database backup D. Fallback snapshot

Which file system locations do you need to specify when installing the SAP HANA multi-host database system using the default settings? (Choose two.) A. /usr/sap/<SID> B. /hana/shared C. /hana/log/<SID> D. /usr/sap/hostctrl

Which rules should you consider when creating a table distribution plan for SAP Business Suite powered by SAP HANA to get the best possible results? (Choose two.) A. Keep all partitions on different hosts. B. Keep the number of partitions per table high. C. Keep the number of key columns low. D. Keep the number of partitioned tables low.
Which features do you need to activate before you can analyze the memory usage of running SQL statements? (Choose two.) A. Memory tracking B. In-memory tracing C. Statement memory limit D. Tracking
Which system privilege must you have to restrict features for tenant databases in the SAP HANA cockpit? A. DATABASE ADMIN B. WORKLOAD ADMIN C. INIFILE ADMIN D. RESOURCE ADMIN
Which tool do you use to check that the actual size of the backup file is the same as the size recorded in the backup file header? A. hdbbackupcheck B. hdbbackupdiag C. hdbbackint D. hdbrecovercheck

In which situations can you resume the failed recovery of your productive SAP HANA tenant database? (Choose two.) A. An aborted recovery of the configuration files B. An aborted recovery of a delta data backup C. An aborted recovery of a log backup D. An aborted recovery of a complete data backup

Which technology is used to install the SAP Landscape Management tool? A. SAP NetWeaver Application Server for ABAP B. SAP NetWeaver Application Server for Java C. SAP HANA XS advanced runtime D. SAP Fiori launchpad

In which scenario do you need SAP expert sizing? (Choose two.) A. When migrating existing SAP ERP systems from AnyDB to run on SAP HANA B. Consolidating multiple SAP ERP source systems into one SAP ERP system on SAP HANA C. Carving out SAP ERP functionality from the source system to the SAP ERP system on SAP HANA D. Customers is new to SAP ERP applications and the SAP HANA database system.

What is the correct sequence of the following four steps when you restart the SAP HANA database system? A. 1. Aborted transactions are rolled back. 2. Open transactions are recovered. 3. Row tables are loaded into memory. 4. Column tables are loaded. B. 1. Row tables are loaded into memory. 2. Open transactions are recovered. 3. Aborted transactions are rolled back. 4. Column tables are loaded. C. 1. Row tables are loaded into memory. 2. Column tables are loaded. 3. Open transactions are recovered. 4. Aborted transactions are rolled back. D. 1. Aborted transactions are rolled back. 2. Row tables are loaded into memory. 3. Open transactions are recovered. 4. Column tables are loaded.

You are running a database migration option (DMO) procedure using in-place migration. Where are the reading and writing R3load processes located during the actual migration? A. All of the reading and writing processes run on the target database host. B. The reading processes run on the source database host; the writing processes run on the target database host. C. The reading processes run on the primary application server (PAS) host; the writing processes run on the target database host. D. All of the reading and writing processes run on the primary application server (PAS) host.

How can you ensure that a consistent database status is saved using data snapshots? A. Trigger a savepoint. B. Execute the hdbbackupdiag tool. C. Create an internal database snapshot. D. Create a fallback snapshot.

You are registering an SAP HANA database resource using SAP HANA cockpit manager. Which privileges are automatically assigned when you initially create the COCKPIT_MONITOR technical user? (Choose two.) A. CATALOG READ B. SELECT on the _SYS_TELEMETRY schema C. SELECT on the _SYS_STATISTICS schema D. DATABASE ADMIN

Which prerequisites must be fulfilled before adding hosts to an SAP HANA scale-out system? (Choose two.) A. The additional host is placed in a different data center. B. The SAP HANA database server is shut down C. The host has access to the installation directories. D. The SAP HANA system installation is on a shared file system.
When performing a standard SAP HANA database system installation, which users will be created or validated during that installation? (Choose two.) A. SYSTEM B. sapadm C. SAP<SID> D. <sid>crypt
Which database objects can you manipulate if you have the object privilege activity ALL PRIVILEGES? (Choose two.) A. Views B. Procedures C. Functions D. Schemas
